narration:0:1524652001:0.text: After setting the bait, you settle into the shadows, quietly waiting.
narration:0:1524652001:0.source_cn: 布置好诱饵后，你们埋伏在暗处，静静等待
narration:0:1524652001:0.male: After setting the bait, you settle into the shadows, quietly waiting.
narration:0:1524652001:0.female: After setting the bait, you settle into the shadows, quietly waiting.

narration:1:1524652002:0.text: Moments later, a massive crocodile lazily drags itself out of the river...
narration:1:1524652002:0.source_cn: 片刻后，一条巨大的鳄鱼从河道中优哉游哉地爬了出来……

narration:2:1524652003:0.text: The hunters roar and charge! The hunt begins!
narration:2:1524652003:0.source_cn: 狩猎队的战士们怒吼着冲了出去。是时候开始围猎了！
